obligations.note: At head, the new route GET /exports/cases.csv maps to EXPORT_CASES (privileged) with mfaRequired=true, and HttpApp.checkBindings keeps handlers and routes in one-to-one correspondence, so the code looks compliant. The exhaustive control test RoutesControlTest#privilegedRoutesRequireMfa only appears in JUnit reports that cannot be tied to this change's CI run (see CHG-4), so adequate evidence is not established.

Ticket CHG-25823 is a standard ticket approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) at 2026-10-14T21:22Z, before the change opened. Its component mortgage.http covers both touched files, HttpApp.java and Routes.java.
The code_review approval is from Declan Farrell, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage. He is a different person from the author, Wen Li (p-wli).
Both approvals name the head commit 34c48cd6, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json names commit 34c48cd6 on ci-runner-07, started 2026-10-15T13:22Z. The attached JUnit reports instead carry hostname dev-laptop-7.local and timestamp 2026-10-23T13:30:10, which is after the review time of 2026-10-19, and each suite is duplicated. The reports are therefore not valid output of this change's CI run, so neither the full-suite pass on the final commit nor the MFA-1 control test pass is evidenced.
mortgage.http is security_sensitive. Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on the head commit 34c48cd6.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests, ci/) are touched, so no control_owner approval is needed.
The change is not an emergency and the ticket type is standard, so no post-implementation review is due.
No exception is relied on for this change. The only MFA-1 exception for mortgage, EXC-0172, is withdrawn and is not used.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers HttpApp.java or Routes.java; ACR-0404 covers payments routes.py only. No prior evidence lapses.

summary: The change adds a privileged, MFA-required CSV alias route for the case export, and the ticket, independent code review and security review are all in order. However, the JUnit reports attached as the change's CI evidence cannot belong to the recorded run. They come from a personal workstation rather than the CI executor, are timestamped days after the review time, and repeat each suite twice. Because the required test evidence on the final commit is invalid, CHG-4 is refuted and MFA-1 cannot be shown with adequate evidence, so the change is rejected.
